summary: Iteration 43: frontend-only test of the Data Guardian finalization (PR #10), run on the web preview at 390x844. Node suite: 28 pass, 0 fail, including progress.test.mjs, which was broken before. Everything requested PASSED. (1) LEGACY WARNING: a valid double-JSON biblia_state with xp 77, plus every guardian slot tampered (bad hash), shows guardian-blocked with the title 'Nur ein älterer Speicherstand ist lesbar' and the button guardian-accept-legacy (342x52). All guardian keys stay byte-identical before confirmation. After tapping, the app loads xp 77, writes live-a and week-a with valid hashes, and loads normally after reload. (2) FONTS: the blocking title uses Fraunces and the body and button use Nunito, with theme colors. (3) RECOVERY NOTICE: three cases were tested: tampered older live-a hash, tampered newest live payload, tampered week-a. Each shows guardian-notice. guardian-notice-dismiss (44x44) hides it and repairs the broken slot (rewritten with a valid hash). The notice does not come back after reload. (4) BUSY LOCK: a MutationObserver caught guardian-busy during reset, undo, weekly restore and JSON import. It is full screen (390x844, zIndex 100), elementFromPoint hits the overlay (touches are blocked), it shows the message 'Lernstand wird gesichert und ersetzt … Änderungen sind währenddessen gesperrt', and it stays about 50-90 ms. State is correct afterwards: reset gives xp 0, guardian-undo gives xp 50 back, and the weekly restore works. (5) MONTHLY REMINDER: the switch is off by default and the key is absent. Turning it on writes {enabled:true,lastExport:null} and the backup-reminder banner appears (also after reload). Tapping the banner text opens /settings. backup-reminder-dismiss hides it and sets snoozedUntil to now+7d, and it stays hidden after reload. full-backup-button downloads biblia-vollsicherung-<date>.json, sets lastExport, clears the snooze, and the row shows '· zuletzt 20.11.2026'. With the snooze removed and a recent export the banner stays hidden. A lastExport 31 days old makes it reappear. Turning the switch off hides it. (6) REGRESSION: JSON export -> modified xp 33 -> import -> import-confirm-button works (before-change created, profile shows 33 EP). An incomplete import (no stations/notes) is rejected and no import-sheet opens. Full backup -> reset -> full-restore-button -> restore-confirm-button -> file brings xp 33 back. State persists after reload. No console or page errors in any run. Two issues found (see below): the notice/reminder banner now renders at the BOTTOM of the screen, and after accepting the legacy state the remaining broken slots produce a second recovery notice on the next launch.

ui_bugs.issue: <GuardianNotices /> is rendered AFTER <Stack> in the flex root View (app/_layout.tsx:55). The banner therefore appears at the very bottom, BELOW the tab bar (measured y=784..844 on 844 height), and pushes the tab bar up by about 60px while it is visible. The banner still uses paddingTop: insets.top + 8 (GuardianNotices.tsx:42/51), so it was meant for the top. On native iOS this puts a status-bar-sized gap above the text at the bottom, and there is no bottom inset, so the home indicator overlaps the dismiss X. In iteration 42 the banner was rendered above the Stack. This is a layout change.

Setup: all 5 slots tampered plus legacy. After guardian-accept-legacy only live-a and week-a are rewritten. live-b, week-b and before-change stay invalid ('bad' hash). On the NEXT launch the user sees 'Ein älterer intakter Speicherstand wurde geladen' right after already confirming the legacy warning. Dismissing it repairs the slots, but this is a confusing double warning. Fix: call guardian.repair() (enqueued, after the first save) inside acceptLegacy. Reference: store.tsx:169-179, data-guardian-core.ts:96

issues: backup-reminder-switch renders 40x20 on web (below 44pt). It is fine on native Switch, but the row could be made tappable.
The reminder banner Pressable (text 'Tippen für Einstellungen') has no testID, and the banner also shows while already on /settings.

action_items: MEDIUM: In app/_layout.tsx, render the banner part of GuardianNotices (guardian-notice/backup-reminder) BEFORE <Stack> so it sits at the top with insets.top. Keep the guardian-busy absoluteFill overlay AFTER <Stack>, for example by splitting it into <GuardianBanner/> above and <GuardianBusy/> below, so the tab bar is no longer pushed up and the banner does not sit under the home indicator.

LOW: In acceptLegacy (store.tsx), enqueue guardian.repair() after the first save so the remaining corrupt slots (live-b/week-b/before-change) are rewritten and no second recovery notice appears on the next launch.

LOW (optional): useBackupReminder freezes 'now' at mount. GuardianNotices mounts once at the root, so a reminder that becomes due while the app stays in the background only shows after a cold start. Consider re-evaluating on AppState 'active'.
critical_code_review_comments: data-guardian.ts native read: the document dir and the guardian dir are listed once and cached in the 'known' Set, which is reset in createGuardian. write() adds to 'known'. Repeated directory scans are removed, as requested. One I/O error during listing rejects open(), and the app is then blocked (safe). Note that the first scan lists the whole Paths.document directory once. This is acceptable.

data-guardian-core open(): when all slots are invalid and legacy is present, it returns legacyFallback without setting opened, so save() stays locked until acceptLegacy(). Verified that nothing is written before confirmation.
repair() correctly writes broken LIVE slots with revision+1 and non-live slots with the current revision. dismissRecovery runs it through the enqueue chain.

replace() sets changing and busy. update() and completeStation ignore edits while changing, so edits during import/reset/restore are dropped silently behind the overlay, and the overlay explains why. Settings buttons are also disabled through the local busy flag.
No deprecated expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) were found.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; 1 MEDIUM layout issue (banner at bottom), 1 LOW issue

seed_data_creation: None. Each browser run used a fresh, isolated localStorage context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation run starts with empty localStorage. Close the intro with 'Überspringen' then 'Bibel entdecken'. A valid guardian slot can be crafted in the page with crypto.subtle SHA-256 over JSON.stringify([1, revision, at, payload]) and stored as {version:1,revision,at,payload,hash}. Note: the tool output garbles the literal text 'live-b":[' as binary, so print slot names in another form (e.g. live_b). The busy overlay is only visible for about 50-90 ms, so capture it with a MutationObserver. JSON import and full restore on web use a file chooser (page.expect_file_chooser). Export and full backup trigger downloads.
rca_of_issue: Banner at bottom: GuardianNotices was moved into a fragment placed after <Stack> in the column-flex root View so that the busy overlay stacks above it. As a side effect the banner rows became normal flex children below the Stack (and the tab bar). Legacy double notice: acceptLegacy() only sets opened=true. The broken Set filled by open() is never processed because repair() runs only from dismissRecovery.
